featured.name: TruckersMP's Halloween Convoy
featured.description:
### Our Halloween Convoy of 2026 has been scheduled and you're **all invited**!  

  The event takes place on the **31st October 2026** at **17:00 UTC!**  

---

   ### **Information** 
   
   We will take to the roads of ETS2 in the dead of night during the witching hour. 
   Are you brave enough to enter? Who knows what might be lurking in the shadows!  
   
   You can find all the details via our [Blog Post](link)  
   
   ### :parking: | **Parking** 
   
   > You may park at any company available in **Paris** with a **no collision zone**.

featured.name: Official ETS2 Convoy - October 2026
featured.description:
### Our Official October Convoy of 2026 has been scheduled and you're **all invited**! 👀  

> This month, we are heading to Daugavpils, traveling through the Baltic area to end in Saint Petersburg.

The event takes place on the **24th October 2026** at **17:00 UTC!**  


---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your time by zone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P2n_zTokGmtO6)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/38163.1790793179.png)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **Daugavpils** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you to what company to park in.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](hhttps://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/121230-official-ets2-convoy-october-2026/)**!

departure.location: Any City in The play area

arrive.location: Any City in The play area

featured.description:
Some of our ghosts went missing from the pumpkin farm so we think they are hiding in some of the trailers. 
   We need your help to find all seven different coloured ghosts around the area. 
   These ghosts only come out at night, so the pitch black sky will add an extra challenge to locating them! 
   Will you be the one to find them the quickest?
   But beware: the cheeky joker ghost loves to play tricks and jump around the play area. 
   Can you find him before he jumps to a new location?  

 You can find more information on our [Blog](https://truckersmp.com/blog/349)

   The event will begin on **1st of November 15:00 UTC** and you have until **1st of November 19:00 UTC** to find all the ghosts.
	 
 # You can park in any city within the play area

today.name: China Friendship Team October Event
today.description:
中国友谊团队于2025年6月4日正式重组。团队始终秉持“共同发展、互助协作”的初心，汇聚了多支创始车队。在团队中，成员之间始终保持密切交流与无私帮助，不仅多次开展内部经验分享，更致力于构建一个携手共进的发展共同体。

尽管团队在成立初期经历了一些磨合与挑战，但凭借坚定的信念与不断的努力，大家逐渐融合为一个紧密团结的整体。在每一次大型活动中，我们都会认真总结经验、查找不足，并共同探讨优化方案，从而持续提升活动的流畅度与参与体验。

多支车队均为团队的创始成员，彼此之间没有高低之分，始终保持着平等沟通、协同决策的良好氛围，共创团队美好未来。

today.name: WITH ANIMALS FROM JUTLAND TO SCANDINAVIA!
today.description:
## WITH ANIMALS FROM JUTLAND TO SCANDINAVIA!
- Se zvířaty z Jutska do srdce Skandinávie!
## 

-----

![](https://i.imgur.com/KYjgumH.png)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/jD3mPFj/CONVOY-RULES.png)


1. Respect the instructions on our Discord server - **Luky Transport Discord Server.**
2. Drive according to the rules and avoid accidents.
3. Follow company rules, they are of great importance.
4. Stick to the prescribed schedule and convoy plan.
5. Have your job and truck ready at the start of the convoy. (FULL FUEL)
6. Cargo is limited for the animal trailers - pigs, cows.
7. Confirm your participation.
8. If your company has more than 5 members and you want to participate, you must reserve a slot on our Discord server - [link here.](https://discord.gg/lukytransport)


-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/PCv3Xb9/schedule.png)

*  **18:00**  - Meetup at Aalborg (primary), or Esbjerg slots.
*  **18:30** -  Departure from the Esbjerg and Aalbrog.
*  **18:45** -  Meetup of both convoys on the route E20.
*  **18:55**  - Passage over Øresund Bridge - Denmark.
*  **19:05**  - Passage around the city of Malmö.
*  **19:10**  - Pause at the gas station near Malmö.
*  **19:20** -  Departure from the pause!
*  **19:45** -  Final Photo and end of the convoy!

![](https://i.imgur.com/qPEhXyX.png)

![](https://i.imgur.com/7YBRGod.png)

For this, simply use the new slot feature on our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/lukytransport).

**Correct Registration Procedure:**

1. [Select your slot](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225995618955300874) with the code number in the room or on the convoy page.

today.name: Oktober Konvoi Der Fire Phoenix
today.description:
Wir starten um 20 Uhr unseren Oktober Monatskonvoi auf den Türkischen Straßen von Edirne aus in Richtung Jassy. (~1.330Km), guckt bitte das ihr rechtzeitig bereit steht und vorm Konvoi Start bitte die LKWs Repariert und Auftankt damit der Start reibungslos ablaufen kann und keine Probleme mit den LKWs unterwegs entstehen können.

Es wird bei diesem Konvoi eine 15 Minütige Pause eingeplant die in Pitesti auf den Speditionen Kaarfor u. Dom Depo Stattfinden wird. 

Folgender DLS ist erforderlich: https://store.steampowered.com/app/227310/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2__Going_East/?curator_clanid=4419325

Wir Starten von Edirne mit Singletrailer (Maximal 10T Fracht) in Fahrtrichtung Landschaft. 

Zum Abschluss bleiben wir an der Spedition Kaarfor um Paar Gruppenbilder nach der Gemeinsamen fahrt zu machen, dafür Parken/stellen wir die Auflieger ein/zur Seite damit die nicht stören oder im Weg stehen
today.rule:
Es gilten die Standart Konvoi regeln:
- Überholen ist Strickt untersagt. Wenn Fremdfahrer auf der Karte oder im Tab auftauchen sollten, Passieren lassen
- Konvoispitze gibt die Geschwindigkeit an, versucht bitte mindestens 100 Meter zu eurem Vorderman einzuhalten um rechzeitig reagieren zu können (ausweichen/Bremsen)

today.description:
![](https://i.ibb.co/sdwb99Mr/d-aboutus.png)  

> Ghost Express was founded **June 10th, 2020**, by Ghøst with the intentions of creating a community that many people can sit there and call their second home. With years passed, that goal has been achieved with more work and progress being made day by day to continue improving what is provided for over 200+ members.
